metadata.title: Scalar curvature deformation of isoparametric tubes
metadata.abstract: We resolve Ge's local scalar curvature rigidity conjecture for spherical isoparametric tubes. The conjecture fails throughout its stated radius range for families with at least two distinct principal curvatures, via arbitrarily small smooth deformations supported in any regular annulus. Geodesic balls of radius less than $\frac{\pi}{2}$ are locally rigid under $C^2$ smallness. We also prescribe sufficiently small smooth nonradial scalar-curvature increments with fixed compact interior support, under antipodal symmetry for families with 2, 4, or 6 distinct principal curvatures and without symmetry for families with 3 distinct principal curvatures.

analysis.progressType: 球面等参管的标量曲率刚性反例与处方
analysis.workSummary: 作者否定Ge关于球面等参管的局部标量曲率刚性猜想：至少两个不同主曲率的族在猜想整个半径范围内，任意正则环带都支持任意小的光滑形变。半径小于π/2的测地球在C²小条件下仍局部刚性。还处方有固定紧内部支撑的小非径向标量曲率增量。
techniques: 等参管的局部度量形变
analysis.breakthrough: 区分等参管与测地球的局部刚性，给遍及原猜想半径范围的反例。
analysis.limitations: 非径向处方在主曲率数2、4、6时需对跖对称，3时不需；测地球刚性是半径<π/2且C²小的条件结论，不能扩大至任意管或大形变。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
